import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top Left: Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('Browns_r', len(product_sales))
bars = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top Right: Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# 3. Bottom Left: Average Transaction by Size and Takeaway Status
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
df['is_takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='is_takeaway_label', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72'], width=0.7, edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper left')
ax3.set_xticklabels(size_order, rotation=0)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Bottom Right: Payment Method Distribution with Transaction Count
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
payment_stats = df.groupby('payment_method').agg({
    'total': 'sum',
    'quantity': 'count'
}).rename(columns={'quantity': 'transactions'})

x = range(len(payment_stats))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], payment_stats['total'], width, 
                label='Total Sales ($)', color='#F18F01', edgecolor='white')
ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
bars2 = ax4_twin.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], payment_stats['transactions'], width,
                     label='# Transactions', color='#C73E1D', edgecolor='white')

ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, color='#F18F01')
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, color='#C73E1D')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(payment_stats.index, rotation=15)
ax4.set_title('Sales & Transactions by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Combine legends
lines1, labels1 = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax4_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right')

ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#F18F01')
ax4_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#C73E1D')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
